# Introduction

This document shows the five HTML components. They are
opt-in except the summary list, which the Lua filter applies to
every definition list. All components use the house tokens, so they
adapt to the light and dark themes automatically.

## Summary list

A definition list becomes a key/value table: bold keys in a left
column, values on the right, hairline separators.
